assertions.name: cancelled_commitment_refuses_without_mutation
assertions.detail: Cancelling the reviewed external commitment produced explicit nothing-written UI, zero commands, zero schedule requests, and the unchanged one-row 30-minute plan.

assertions.name: review_refreshes_to_current_availability
assertions.detail: Review Updated Availability replaced 336 available and 60 busy minutes with the current 378 available and zero busy minutes while retaining the reviewed task.

assertions.name: denied_calendar_refuses_and_repairs
assertions.detail: Denied Calendar permission produced explicit nothing-written UI, no commands, an unchanged plan, and Source Health attention with exact impact and repair guidance.

assertions.name: current_approval_applies_exact_writes
assertions.detail: The restored current approval produced four succeeded command rows covering the Calendar block, notification, Reminder priority, and Reminder due date.

assertions.name: receipt_restores_only_after_success
assertions.detail: The single post-success relaunch restored the same plan and the applied four-change receipt; neither refusal branch created a command or applied receipt.

assertions.name: calendar_freshness_rules
assertions.detail: CalendarPlanApprovalStateTests passed 11 tests after the one-time rebase onto the authoritative root.
